description: IEA EBC Annex 60, 'New generation computational tools for building and community energy systems based on the Modelica and Functional Mockup Interface standards', aimed to develop and demonstrate tools that let buildings and community energy grids be designed and operated as integrated, performance-based systems, and to share and extend free open-source modelling work. It created tool chains linking building information models to energy models, building simulation to controls design, and design tools to operation; its final report was published in September 2017, the Modelica Annex 60 library in January 2017, and the work continued as IBPSA Project 1. The report chapter on co-simulation and model exchange with FMI covers use cases, FMI-compliant building and district tools, FMU export, master algorithms and best-practice recommendations. Coverage: international research collaboration. Access: free HTML report on the Annex site. Licence: none stated. Caveats: the tool survey reflects 2017, so versions have moved on. Simulation uses: guidance on coupling building, HVAC and district models through FMI and Modelica. Related records: the Modelica IBPSA library, EnergyPlusToFMU and BCVTB.
